authority: Checks observable execution contracts, records operational facts and prepares independently permitted review content. It does not qualify native judgment, certify source truth, score personal fit, implement or train a model, or establish a benchmark win.
failure_or_lesson: Success-only receipt checks can omit timeouts and over-budget failures. Freezing history alone also leaves mutable questions and stale authorization. Preserve the full denominator, frozen actual questions, live source-use checks and exact recorded outputs; do not turn fixture validation into performance evidence.
goal: Prepare fair failure-inclusive execution and blinded review without training replacement models or inventing behavioral results.
notes: Method seed only; supplied inference adapters and selected-store evidence verification remain to be integrated. Observed token and call totals come from adapter metering, while context bytes and wall time are checked directly. No numerical threshold or score was fabricated.
procedure: Freeze question hashes and exact original event/content histories; independently authorize before execution and recheck after preparation/inference; give the native-update ablation the exact full context; time preparation and execution together; bind actual output to persisted context delivery and decision; retain stops, timeouts, errors and observed budget violations; collect known usage/cost without filling unknown values; build randomized review content separately from its private identity key.
validation: Eleven local contract regressions passed using fictional inputs, actual Experience/RecordedEvent/record_decision shapes, encrypted local objects and an explicitly labeled in-memory fixture log. No selected-store runner adapter, qualified model inference, serious comparator or provider API was exercised.
